questions.title: Who will score India's first half-century in the July 2026 Twenty20 international series against Zimbabwe?
questions.background: A half-century in cricket is an individual score of at least 50 runs in one innings.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the first Indian batter to reach 50 runs in an innings during the July 2026 men's Twenty20 international series against Zimbabwe, according to official match scorecards and contemporaneous match reports. Resolution Date : 2026-07-23 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the batter's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Major July 7-14 batting form and lineup update ahead of the July 23 Zimbabwe T20I series (Hindustan Times July 12-14, Khaleej Times July 12-13): BCCI's July 12 squad revision replaced only injured bowler Varun Chakaravarthy with Ravi Bishnoi, leaving the Zimbabwe batting squad intact. However, India lost 0-4 to England and 0-2 to Ireland, and 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi failed in all three England T20Is (42 runs across 3 innings, never crossing 20) before being DROPPED for the 5th T20I in Southampton. July 13-14 reporting notes 'it remains to be seen whether he gets any game time' in Zimbabwe, with maiden call-up right-handed opener Prabhsimran Singh (or promoted WK opener Ishan Kishan) creating ~50-55% risk that Sooryavanshi is benched for the 1st T20I in Harare (when India's first 50 is most likely scored). Cutting Sooryavanshi sharply 0.17 -> 0.11 (#4), elevating captain Shreyas Iyer 0.13 -> 0.16 (#3, cited by HT July 12 as the only Indian batter who looked accomplished in England and guaranteed #3/#4 starter), boosting locked-in opener Abhishek Sharma 0.26 -> 0.28 (prior Harare T20I centurion) and guaranteed top-3 starter Ishan Kishan 0.21 -> 0.23 (world #1 T20I batter, could also open), and holding vice-captain Tilak Varma at 0.10 (guaranteed #4/#5 starter with improved 5th T20I form), leaving 12% residual led by Prabhsimran Singh (~8%), Shivam Dube (~2%), and Rinku Singh (~1.5%).

questions.title: Which European country will declare a national emergency in response to wildfires between July 1 and July 25, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official national government announcements or reliable news reporting published by July 25, 2026. Resolution Condition : Identify the European country whose national government declares a national emergency because of wildfires between July 1 and July 25, 2026. Regional or local emergency declarations alone do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The country's commonly used English name.
questions.current_reasoning: 2026-07-17 breaking update from AFP and Reuters (Straits Times): Spain surges (+0.05, 0.21 -> 0.26) into a near-tie with Portugal after a fast-moving wildfire near Ores in Aragon expanded to nearly 14,000 hectares on July 17 (1,000+ evacuated, 400+ firefighters, 300 military emergency responders, 30 aircraft battling 'crazy' shifting winds), alongside a new 2,000-hectare blaze in Guadalajara forcing 11 village evacuations and fires near Madrid—all erupting just one week after 13 deaths in Almería. Crucially, Spain's AEMET warned on July 17 that temperatures will climb again from July 18 to 42-44°C in Andalusia and La Mancha next week with 'extreme wildfire risk,' markedly raising the chance Madrid invokes a national Nivel 3 civil protection emergency across multiple regions. Portugal trims modestly (0.29 -> 0.27) but retains #1 due to its lower unitary-state escalation bar from its existing mainland State of Alert and exposure to the same July 18+ Iberian heatwave. Greece holds at 0.14 with Athens placed on high wildfire alert July 17; North Macedonia trims slightly to 0.11; France drops (0.05 -> 0.03) as MeteoFrance reported the Western European heatwave receding into thunderstorms following Fontainebleau's containment. Retaining 19% residual tail for Bulgaria, Cyprus, Italy, Albania, Croatia, Montenegro, and Turkey.

questions.title: What type of munition will be confirmed destroyed in Syria's first OPCW-verified chemical-weapons destruction operation since 2014?
questions.background: The Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW) verifies the destruction of chemical weapons and associated munitions.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the type of munition identified as destroyed in Syria's first OPCW-verified chemical-munitions destruction operation since 2014, as reported to the UN Security Council by 2026-09-03. Resolution Date : 2026-09-03 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the specific munition type, excluding its quantity.
questions.current_reasoning: Major OPCW development on 2026-07-09: at its 112th session, the OPCW Executive Council reinstated Syria's voting rights and formally approved a detailed verification plan for the destruction of Category 3 chemical weapons at Al Qutayfah (37 km north of Damascus), alongside facility agreements for the Al Qutayfah and Homs CW storage sites (OPCW press release, AP News July 9). Under the CWC, Category 3 strictly denotes unfilled military chemical munitions and devices—effectively excluding improvised industrial chlorine cylinders (0.06 -> removed) from this first operation and concentrating probability on the two unfilled Assad-era binary munition types highlighted in OPCW's May 27 discovery report: aerial bombs of the Ltamenah/Khan Shaykhun type (0.38 -> 0.42) and rockets of the Ghouta type (0.32 -> 0.34). Artillery shells hold at 0.07, unfilled missile warheads enter at 0.05 reflecting Al Qutayfah's historical missile/CW depot role and Syria's prior Category 3 inventory, mortar shells edge to 0.04, and 8% tail mass covers other specific Category 3 designations or devices.

local_articles.title: Syria’s Al-Sharaa reshuffles security and intelligence leadership
local_articles.snippet: President Ahmed al-Sharaa has overhauled Syria’s security and intelligence leadership, expanding the powers of his interior minister and installing a new intelligence chief as part of a broader shake-up of state security bodies. The changes announced on Sunday saw Interior Minister Anas Khattab handed an additional role as head of the National Security Bureau, which oversees Syria’s various security agencies, while continuing to run the interior ministry, reported the state news agency SANA. questions.title: Which country will win the men's team gymnastics gold medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
questions.background: The Commonwealth Games men's team gymnastics competition awards medals according to the final team standings.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Commonwealth Games results, corroborated by contemporary reliable news reporting. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the country awarded gold in the men's team gymnastics competition at the 2026 Commonwealth Games, once the final standings are announced. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the winning country.
questions.current_reasoning: Two major developments since June 24 significantly narrow the England-Canada gap ahead of the July 24 Glasgow 2026 men's team final: (1) Three-time Olympic champion Max Whitlock withdrew on July 13 with a hand injury sustained in training (BBC Sport, Reuters), removing an elite pommel horse specialist and disrupting England's late-stage lineup, while Team England's Chef de Mission noted the squad mixes Olympic/world medallists with several multi-sport debutants; (2) Gymnastics Canada officially named a powerhouse A-team on July 3—Paris Olympians Félix Dolci, René Cournoyer, and William Émard plus Jordan Carroll and Ethan Ikeda—fresh off winning historic team gold at the 2026 Pan American Championships (with Émard winning rings gold and Carroll pommel horse silver). England remains the clear favorite given its unmatched all-around/apparatus depth and three straight CWG team titles, but trims 0.74 -> 0.64 while Canada jumps sharply 0.13 -> 0.25; Australia (young squad, 4 debutants) trims 0.06 -> 0.05, Cyprus holds 0.03, and host Scotland trims 0.03 -> 0.02 (1% residual).

questions.title: Which club will Cape Verde goalkeeper Vozinha join after Chaves in 2026?
questions.background: Vozinha is a Cape Verde international goalkeeper. Chaves is a Portuguese football club.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official club or player announcement, or reliable contemporaneous sports reporting confirming a completed move. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the first club Vozinha joins after leaving Chaves in 2026. Offers, negotiations, and proposed transfers do not count. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the club.
questions.current_reasoning: Important 2026-07-18 reality check from Fabrizio Romano (reported by talkSPORT, Globo Esporte/ge.globo, and RedGol): contrary to yesterday's Bolavip claim that Vozinha had already approved Colo-Colo's terms, Vozinha's camp actually did NOT accept Colo-Colo's initial proposal and responded with a counter-offer. Crucially, Colo-Colo is now actively choosing between free-agent Vozinha and Monterrey's Uruguayan international goalkeeper Santiago Mele, while Romano adds Vozinha holds additional offers from other South American clubs. Meanwhile, ge.globo explicitly confirms Brazilian clubs Ceara, Avai, and Atletico Goianiense all opted not to open negotiations after being offered the keeper (and Corinthians rejected him). Trimming Colo-Colo from 0.52 -> 0.40 (still clear #1 favorite given formal offer, coach Fernando Ortiz's backing, and free-agent status vs. Mele), trimming speculative Inter Miami 0.12 -> 0.08, and cutting Ceara/Avai/Atletico Goianiense to 0.01 each, leaving 49% residual for unnamed South American or other clubs.

questions.current_reasoning: Major 2026-07-18 prediction-market realignment (Kalshi News July 18, Yahoo Sports, ESPN/Shams Charania, Marc Stein, Dave McMenamin, AFP/Straits Times): Miami Heat surged dramatically on Kalshi to 53% (up from 15% Thursday, 17% Friday morning, and 32% later Friday), overtaking Cleveland Cavaliers (falling to 24%), Golden State Warriors (crashing from a 33-40% Thu/Fri spike down to 14%), and Philadelphia 76ers (12%), with Kalshi pricing an 85% chance James announces before July 26. Insider reporting aligns strongly with the Heat move: Pat Riley explicitly teased 'now there's another [plane] we have to land' at Giannis Antetokounmpo's July 16 Miami introduction; Marc Stein highlighted Miami alongside Cleveland and Philadelphia as the three Eastern suitors receiving serious consideration; Dave McMenamin confirmed Miami 'remains a realistic possibility'; and Shams Charania said James has finished collecting pitches ('decision time'), called Miami a 'complete contender the moment he gets there,' and damped Warriors buzz by citing zero trade traction for Anthony Davis or another star. After removing Kalshi's ~3-5% overround and applying modest shrinkage for recent market whiplash and unconfirmed-decision discipline (staying <=0.50), Miami Heat jumps sharply to #1 (0.15 -> 0.49), Cleveland Cavaliers falls to #2 (0.40 -> 0.25), Golden State Warriors drops to #3 (0.27 -> 0.13), Philadelphia 76ers trims (0.13 -> 0.11), and Minnesota Timberwolves trims (0.03 -> 0.01), leaving 1% residual tail.

questions.title: Which club will sign Yan Diomande from RB Leipzig in summer 2026?

Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the destination club in the first such agreement announced between June 1 and August 31, 2026. Loan agreements do not count. questions.current_reasoning: Major 2026-07-15 update from Sport Bild (via Bulinews) breaks PSG's perceived lock and sharply widens the transfer race: (1) as of July 15, PSG have STILL not submitted an official bid—only Liverpool have made a formal offer (EUR 80m + EUR 20m add-ons, rejected by RB Leipzig); (2) Diomande has reportedly given his green light to several clubs rather than PSG alone, with at least Liverpool, Paris Saint-Germain, Manchester City, and Manchester United all believing they are in pole position; (3) no suitor currently wants to exceed EUR 100m against Leipzig's EUR 120m asking price (Leipzig are pushing for a contract extension, though Diomande expects to leave). Weighting Tier-1 BBC Sport/AFP/L'Equipe reporting (PSG personal-terms edge, active Leipzig talks alongside Akliouche, Ramos and Lee Kang-in sold) alongside Sport Bild's multi-club update cuts Paris Saint-Germain sharply (0.55 -> 0.38), lifts Liverpool (0.24 -> 0.28), brings Manchester City (0.12) and Manchester United (0.09) into the top 5 (pushing Chelsea and Real Madrid into the 9% residual tail), and keeps Bayern Munich at 0.04 (explicitly named earlier by RB chief Mintzlaff).
